alerts.title: South India truckers' strike confirmed active: 4,000+ daily loads halted on Karnataka-TN corridor
alerts.summary: The indefinite strike threatened over VLTD/panic-button mandates and toll costs is now confirmed active. By Aug 2, over 4,000 daily loads on the Karnataka–Tamil Nadu corridor had stopped, roughly 6 lakh lorries in Karnataka are off the road, and Chennai is already seeing produce-supply shortages from the Kolar belt — mirroring Rajasthan's separate, ongoing VLTD strike.
alerts.impact: Active FM/LM stoppage: Chennai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kochi and Coimbatore hub linehaul is severely constrained. Activate alternate LM 3P capacity immediately, flag non-serviceable (NS) pincodes dependent on truck linehaul, and extend SLA relaxation across the southern zone until the strike resolves.

alerts.title: Assam flood toll nears 80, 2.12 lakh affected across 8 districts; Arunachal & Nagaland also under IMD alert
alerts.summary: Assam's flood emergency has escalated sharply — death toll near 80 with over 2.12 lakh people affected across 437 villages in 21 revenue circles spanning Golaghat, Sivasagar, Biswanath, Charaideo, Kamrup Metro, Jorhat, Dhemaji and Nagaon districts; the Brahmaputra and tributaries remain above danger levels in places, though waters are receding in Upper Assam. Arunachal Pradesh (~1.5 lakh affected) and Nagaland (8+ deaths in Mon district) also remain under IMD orange alerts, with PM Modi having pledged Central assistance.
alerts.impact: Serviceability loss risk widens across Upper Assam — extend NS flags for the 8 affected districts, monitor Guwahati hub inbound linehaul closely, and coordinate contingency LM/FM capacity with Delhivery/Xpressbees for alternate Northeast routing as floodwaters recede.

alerts.title: NH-44 Jammu-Srinagar partially reopens Aug 3 for light vehicles; heavy trucks still alternate-day only
alerts.summary: NH-44 reopened for light motor vehicles on Aug 3 after being fully closed since Aug 1 due to fresh landslides, shooting stones and slushy conditions near Dawal Bridge (Udhampur) and Gangroo (Ramban) — the second closure spell in under a week. Heavy vehicles, including freight trucks, remain restricted to alternate-day movement only, with single-lane bottlenecks persisting at Dewal and between Marog-Kishtwari Pather.
alerts.impact: Kashmir Valley linehaul stays constrained even with light traffic resumed — Srinagar, Baramulla and Anantnag hubs still face TAT breaches since freight HMVs move only on alternate days. Maintain buffer stock at the Jammu hub and hold SLA-relaxation flags for Valley pincodes until full HMV movement resumes.

alerts.title: 108+ roads still blocked across Himachal Pradesh as IMD heavy-rain alert runs through Aug 4
alerts.summary: 108 roads remain closed across Himachal Pradesh — 39 in Mandi, 33 in Kullu, 11 in Shimla, 9 in Sirmaur, 7 in Chamba and 5 in Kangra — after torrential rain damage; 9 transformers and 38 water-supply schemes are also disrupted. IMD has an orange alert for Kangra/Mandi/Chamba and yellow alert for Shimla/Kullu/Sirmaur, with isolated heavy rain expected through Aug 7.
alerts.impact: FM linehaul into hill hubs (Shimla, Mandi, Kullu) faces repeated single-lane or no-access windows through the week — hold flexible SLAs and avoid new dispatch commitments to blocked-road pincodes until district lists clear.

alerts.title: Rajasthan truckers' indefinite strike over VLTD costs grounds 10,000+ trucks
alerts.summary: The Rajasthan Truck Transport Sangharsh Samiti has kept over 10,000 trucks off the road in an indefinite strike against VLTD costs (₹25,000-30,000 in Rajasthan vs ₹3,000-3,500 in neighbouring states), permit hurdles, fitness-renewal rules and e-detection challans. Associations warn of disruption to steel, cement, grocery and agri-produce movement if talks with the state government fail.
alerts.impact: Expect FM linehaul delays out of Jaipur, Jodhpur and Kota hubs; line up alternate 3P capacity or inter-state rerouting for Rajasthan-bound dispatches and pre-position buffer stock at bordering hubs.

alerts.title: Landslide shuts NH-2 Kohima-Mao stretch daily 6am-6pm, cutting key Nagaland-Manipur link
alerts.summary: Active sliding debris at the Phesama sinking zone on NH-2 (Kohima-Mao section, Km 191.8-192.1) has forced district authorities to close the stretch daily from 6am-6pm for restoration work — the only major highway link between Nagaland and Manipur.
alerts.impact: Expect daytime transit delays for Dimapur/Kohima-Imphal linehaul; schedule FM dispatches for the overnight open window and flag partial-day SLA relaxation for Manipur-bound shipments routed via this corridor.

alerts.title: Kanwar Yatra: Delhi-Haridwar highway bars heavy vehicles from Aug 4; GT Road fully shuts Aug 9-12
alerts.summary: Delhi Police and UP authorities will restrict heavy-vehicle movement on the Delhi-Haridwar National Highway and Ganga Canal road from Aug 4, and close the UP stretch of the Delhi-Meerut Expressway to regular traffic entirely from Aug 7-12, reserving lanes for Kanwar Yatra pilgrims through the yatra's Aug 11 conclusion. HTVs have already been diverted off GT Road, Wazirabad Road and Vikas Marg since Jul 30, and GT Road between Apsara Border and Yamuna Bridge will close fully to general traffic from 7am Aug 9 to 8pm Aug 12 for peak pilgrim movement.
alerts.impact: Reroute FM linehaul between Delhi NCR and the Haridwar/Meerut/Dehradun corridor around the restriction windows via NH-9, NH-44, the Eastern Peripheral Expressway and Delhi-Dehradun Expressway; build 3-4 days of transit buffer for affected pincodes, especially the Aug 9-12 peak closure.

alerts.title: Petrol/diesel hold at multi-city highs for 11th straight week; LPG/CNG unchanged
alerts.summary: Retail petrol and diesel prices remain steady since OMCs' May 25 hike — Delhi ₹102.12/₹95.20, Mumbai ₹111.18/₹99.82, Bengaluru ₹111.68/₹99.56, Hyderabad ₹115.73/₹103.82, Chennai ₹107.87/₹99.65 (petrol/diesel per litre). LPG, CNG and PNG rates remain unchanged for over a month.
alerts.impact: No immediate LM/FM disruption; sustained elevated fuel levels combined with the ongoing south India and Rajasthan trucker strikes raise near-term risk of 3P fuel-surcharge asks — track weekly for signals from Delhivery/Shadowfax/Xpressbees ahead of the next pricing cycle.
